answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the pearl of a task receipt, and the gale is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the umber of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
